## Next actions

- `publish` for unit/claim-corrections: Publish the unit after its acceptance gates pass.

## Not mechanically provable

Vouch checks only what artifacts can prove; where it cannot, it prints `NOT_CHECKED` rather than offering a button that fakes it.

- org.acceptance-ownership: a recorded owner identity proves a string was recorded, not that a person with authority and time validated intent
- org.intent-validation: whether the frozen pack tests *the right thing* is human judgment; red proves cases CAN fail, not that they should
- org.independence: identity comparison is a format heuristic (the 0.6 commit-author lesson), never proof of distinct people
- org.causal-red-history: an anchored chain proves ordering and anchor timing; no anchor mode proves *why* the red occurred
- org.protective-closure-truthfulness: a closure record proves a trigger and roster snapshot were recorded, not that the trigger was real or the response appropriate
- org.tier-controls: standard: Declared effects (transform, observation, action) [typed-contracts] is required — PARTIALLY CHECKED (mechanical: check.effects-declared) residual: whether declarations are true and complete is human reviewed; a project's own effect checker is not yet bindable; standard: Acceptance frozen before implementation [acceptance-frozen-before-implementation] is required — PARTIALLY CHECKED (mechanical: check.pack-bound, check.pack-files-match) residual: frozen BEFORE implementation is human attested; the pack's EXECUTION is not verified — runner configuration (conftest.py, pytest.ini, pyproject testpaths) can deselect a bound test; bind those files too; standard: Independence (minimum model) [independence-minimum] is required (critical-behavior; Model 1/2 for critical (per-unit override in ledger)) — NOT CHECKED: the required independence model is human attested; standard: Harness-recorded red→green→refactor [harness-recorded-red-green] is required (chained, CI-signed anchor) — PARTIALLY CHECKED (mechanical: check.evidence-anchors, check.tier.evidence-required, gate.dod.current-pack-green) residual: the recorded order of Vouch's own events is not proof of chronology relative to implementation; recording a command's exit status is not proof that the bound acceptance tests actually executed; standard: Real-boundary tests (observations and actions) [real-boundary-tests] is required — NOT CHECKED: boundary selection and test adequacy are human reviewed; standard: Replay, manifests, content addressing [replay-manifests-content-addressing] is required — NOT CHECKED: replay completeness and content-addressing coverage are human reviewed; standard: Mutation testing [mutation-testing] is risk-triggered (critical-logic) — NOT CHECKED: trigger evaluation NOT CHECKED; residual requirement: mutation scope and surviving-mutant adjudication are human reviewed; standard: Approval-gated actions [approval-gated-actions] is risk-triggered (ledger approval_required) — NOT CHECKED: trigger evaluation NOT CHECKED; residual requirement: approval triggers and authorization policy are human reviewed; standard: Security evidence [security-evidence] is risk-triggered (when triggered, the high-tier blocking outcomes apply) — NOT CHECKED: trigger evaluation NOT CHECKED; residual requirement: security triggers and required blocking outcomes are human reviewed; standard: System map: both gates, full content, owned verifiers [system-map-gates] is required — NOT CHECKED: gate completeness, content adequacy, and verifier ownership are human reviewed; standard: Release map content-addressed in bundle [release-map-in-bundle] is required — NOT CHECKED: release-map bundle inclusion is human reviewed; standard: Map delivered externally [map-delivered-externally] is required (per archetype) — NOT CHECKED: external delivery is human attested; standard: Archetype-Q machinery (sealed procedure, exposure controls, held-out case variants) [archetype-q-machinery] is required (bound to archetype, never tier) — NOT CHECKED: sealed procedure, exposure controls, and held-out variants are human reviewed
